run_plot_network: run the script to plot a mobilenet model network graph as a PNG visualization
run_plot_network_custom_model: run the script with a custom model name and ratio to visualize its network architecture
run_plot_network_with_se: run the script with the --use_se flag to plot a resnext model with SE layers
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that defines CLI arguments for model type, ratio, and SE layer options
review_main: review the main function that loads a model, hybridizes it, and renders a network graph
